A modern IPTV player. It loads the [iptv-org](https://github.com/iptv-org/iptv) public playlist and the [epgshare01](https://epgshare01.online/) TV guide by default.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| **Android** (phones, tablets, Android TV · Android 7.0+) | `LumenTV-<version>.apk` |

### Installing

- **Android**: download the APK on your device and open it. Allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser or file manager when asked.
  On Android TV, sideload it with a file manager or `adb install`.

## What's new in 1.9.2

- **Android TV:** a **Close** button in the player (press OK, then go to the last button) stops the channel. You go back to Home as it looks when the app opens.
  - Holding OK on the playing channel's card on Home also offers **Stop playing**.
- **Phones and tablets** (from 1.9.1):
  - The **✕** in the top-left of the player, or Back on Home, closes the player.
  - Home's search button opens a full search screen.
